name: t021-runtime-gate-a-maintenance
purpose: Offline-prepared, Gate-B-authorized one-exact-forward-transition plus paired rollback for the T021 dev-only public-read fixture (Feature 002, Multica 9GOTSTORY-249). PREPARATION ONLY: no operation in this bundle touches the live runtime unless a valid Gate B approval record is presented.

authority.pr27_state_at_preparation: OPEN/unmerged at e7e21d685563aded31ee9908320426dc7b4d9690 (frozen; not modified by this bundle)

source.note: Exact pair only; ordinary descendant-only promotion is NOT rollback authority. The recorded stable source is the only permitted rollback target.

protected_seed.handling: Advance the checked-out seed/seed.json file together with the exact source SHA without applying seed content or changing native schema. The guard is never omitted or disabled; only this exact hash pair is admitted.

external_dev_config.note: Exactly the accepted unapplied T021 registration proposal: foundation import preserved, root /app, vite spreads preserved, strictPort preserved, one dev-only integration appended. Proposed payload only — no live registration in Gate A.

compose_environment.grammar_note: Key contains digits; the private-env key grammar for this maintenance accepts [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]* with all previously required keys still mandatory and no arbitrary keys accepted.
compose_environment.constraint: Environment change requires app-only container replacement (not a bare restart). PostgreSQL, persistent volumes, networks and all pre-existing secrets are untouched.

capability_client_copy.constraint: Private path configured by environment; no token values, hashes or lengths ever appear in logs, stdout, stderr, argv or evidence. Delivery happens only inside a Gate-B-authorized apply.

app_only_lifecycle: validated app stop before any stable-source or live config/environment change (avoids HMR/partial transitions)
single replacement app container through the reviewed Compose file
guarded recording of the new app container ID (a removed old container ID is never treated as restorable)
bounded unauthenticated health checks; any native-PAT verification is separately authorized and its bookkeeping writes acknowledged
never_touched: second app instance or any additional port

preimage_capture.authority: PO Gate A authorization; O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NOATIME; UID1001 regular files; unchanged inode/size/mtime/ctime/atime; no subprocess/controller/engine/native request
preimage_capture.capture_manifest_sha256_input: see bundle-manifest.json 'preimage_capture' section (hash-only entries copied verbatim from the Lead's capture manifest)
preimage_capture.excluded: runtime.env, dev-access.json, PAT/capability files, raw private state/activation content

required_record_fields: gate_a_candidate_sha (the exact Gate A commit carrying this bundle)
refusal_conditions: wrong candidate SHA or bundle-manifest hash (stale bundle)
operation not approved in the record
installed preimage drift (any installed artifact hash differs from the recorded preimage)
gate_b_binding.no_auto_approval: Gate A never manufactures an active approval; a record is only valid when produced by the Gate B PO/IR decision itself.

prerequisites_not_delegated: Distinct second test-owned native role account/PAT — a Gate B prerequisite; this bundle implements NO account/PAT provisioning and never mutates the shared Administrator
SONGHEALTH_T021_ROUTE_TOKEN value generation and SONGHEALTH_T021_ROUTE_ACCESS client-copy placement (executed only by the Gate-B-authorized apply)
Any live installation, transition, restart/stop, registration, reseed or verification
stop_conditions: any refusal before mutation leaves all preimages untouched
failure after a consequential stage preserves truthful partial state in the maintenance state record and stops; bounded rollback runs only under an explicit Gate B rollback record
unknown/stale/drifted state refuses; a failed or unknown rollback stops for PO decision (no automated retry/recovery loop)
